notes: The supplied *the* of *the two kings* is placed on kings, the noun the numeral counts, and the numeral takes only *two* (rule 15).
The rectum ha-Emori is rendered arthrously, so the article takes the *the* standing before its own word and nothing is fronted (rule 29).
*utterly* is part of the Hiphil verb's own rendering: no infinitive absolute stands in the clause, so rule 56 does not reach it.
The resumptive object suffix of otam is unrepresented, the relative *whom* being the one English realization (rule 22).
